mentions.name: LLC Simulator
mentions.description: A free website that serves as a one-stop guide for people who are looking to start an LLC. Still being built but almost ready, with a goal of completing the site by the end of the month and then focusing on marketing and Google rankings.
mentions.problem: People looking to start an LLC need a single free, comprehensive resource to guide them through the process.
mentions.audience: People looking to start an LLC
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on LLC Simulator at the moment. Still building this but almost ready. Had this sitting in my head for far too long. The whole goal for the website is to be a free one stop guide for people who are looking to start an LLC.
